title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
slides: They claim proof of a major conjecture, others doubt.
The proof may be flawed, but the tool works.
Check your own math with AI—carefully.
One false proof can mislead; verify or ignore.
thread_text:
1. Proof or bluff?

OpenAI claims its AI solved a decades-old math conjecture. Mathematicians are skeptical, and the proof may have holes.

2. A bold claim

The AI produced a proof that experts are now tearing apart. Even if flawed, the tool behind it is real.

3. You can try it

Use AI to check your own math, but carefully. It might be wrong, but it can still help you spot patterns.

4. One false move

A single wrong proof can mislead thousands. Verify everything or ignore the hype.

5. Your turn

Take a math problem you're stuck on. Ask an AI to outline a proof. Then verify each step. Does it hold up?
